overview.title: Trimming
overview.summary: Neat hedges and carefully shaped shrubs, season after season.
overview.description: A little shaping can make a big difference. Neatly trimmed hedges and shrubs bring definition back to your landscape and help the rest of your outdoor space shine.
overview.caption: Good care. Clean lines.

detail.headline: Good care.
detail.introduction: Bring a little definition back to your landscape. Neatly trimmed hedges and shaped shrubs help the spaces around your home or business feel intentional and cared for.
detail.sectionCopy: Hedges and shrubs help frame a property. When those details look tidy, the rest of the landscape comes into focus. We bring care to the trimming work that gives your yard its finished feel.

item1.title: Neatly trimmed hedges
item1.copy: Give established hedges a tidier appearance and bring their lines back into the landscape.

item2.title: Carefully shaped shrubs
item2.copy: Refresh the shape of shrubs around entrances, garden beds, and the other areas you want to highlight.

item3.title: A more finished landscape
item3.copy: Coordinate trimming with the attention your lawn and garden beds need for a cohesive, cared-for look.

detail.planningTitle: Let us see what needs a little shaping.
detail.planningCopy: Photos of the hedges and shrubs are a useful start. Mention their approximate height, the areas you want trimmed, and the look you have in mind.

item1.question: What trimming work can I ask about?
item1.answer: We trim hedges and shrubs. Send photos of what you have in mind so the team can confirm the work for your property.

item2.question: Can trimming be discussed with regular yard care?
item2.answer: Yes. Tell us if you also need lawn care, landscape maintenance, or a seasonal cleanup so we can discuss the services together.

item3.question: How do I explain the shape I want?
item3.answer: Current photos and a reference image can help. Point out any areas you especially want addressed when speaking with the team.
